description_sq:
Apartamenti ndodhet ne zonen e shkolles P.Nini prane Liqenit Artificial.
Pozicionohet ne katin e peste dhe te fundit te nje ndertimi egzistues pa ashensor.
Organizohet nga nje ambient ndenje,nje ambient gatimi tre dhoma gjumi,dy tualete nje depo dhe nje ballkon.
Apartamenti shitet ne gjendjen qe eshte, zoteron dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
Prona eshte e pershtatshem per banim si dhe per investim,sepse ndahet lehtesishte ne disa apartamente.
Per me teper informacion na kontaktoni. IRG130978
description_en: The apartment is located in the area of ​​the P. Nini school near the Artificial Lake. It is located on the fifth and last floor of an existing building without an elevator. It is organized by a living room, a kitchen, three bedrooms, two toilets, a storage room and a balcony. The apartment is sold in the condition it is in, it has regular mortgage documentation. The property is suitable for living as well as for investment, because it is easily divided into several apartments. For more information, contact us. IRG130978
